inventory.visualPurpose: Photograph A — the bone-metastasis spine image beside the Bone row (book 219)
inventory.sourceFigureDescription: An 188x245 8bpc raster, lettered A beside “Predilection for axial skeleton A”: a sagittal MR image of the spine showing the axial skeleton — a grayscale vertebral column with bright fatty marrow and dark CSF/vertebral bodies; red arrows point to metastatic lesions at the labeled vertebral levels T8 and L1 (white labels with red arrows); the white boxed letter A sits at the image's top-left. COPYRIGHTED — described in text, never reproduced.
inventory.kypLocation: described-in-text in the registry visual's photographs panel + blocks[2] the Bone row's bracketed description + blocks[3] the photographs table

inventory.visualPurpose: Photograph B — the gross liver metastases photograph beside the Liver row (book 219)
inventory.sourceFigureDescription: An 188x150 8bpc raster, lettered B beside “Scattered throughout liver parenchyma B”: a gross specimen photograph — the cut surface of two liver halves on a teal/blue-green background; the dark reddish-brown liver parenchyma contains large, pale yellow-white/cream, somewhat nodular metastatic masses with central discoloration (necrosis), one large mass in each half; a small white asterisk (photographer credit) at bottom-right; the white boxed letter B sits at the image's top-left. COPYRIGHTED — described in text, never reproduced.
